name: Earthlings
detailed_description:
Earthlings is a resource and time management game where you lead a tiny group of humans who think they're serving God - but you're actually helping a nobody alien pretend to be an artist.

Meet G, an ordinary grey alien who crashed on Earth and saw his chance. He always dreamed of being an artist but never had the talent. Now he can fake it by stealing human creativity while hiding from you and pretending to be divine.

Master Worker & Resource Management

Every Second Counts! Constantly reassign your few precious workers between gathering resources, defending against attacks, and building monuments before deadlines. Sometimes it's zen-like planning, other times pure panic. Every choice matters when you're running a skeleton crew.

Create Art Strategically

Art or Survival? Mix and match monument part cards to create "masterpieces" that G sells to gullible space buyers. Higher level parts demand rarer materials like silver and gold. Choose parts with game-changing effects - heal all workers, complete buildings instantly, attract merchants, or boost your reputation.

Survive, Upgrade & Progress

Your Boss is a Disaster! Miss deadlines and G panics, triggering sandstorms, enemy attacks, and catastrophes. Fight tough enemies to find keys that unlock new worlds. Earn knowledge points to make your workers faster and stronger so you can eventually face G and end his cosmic scam.

Keep your workers moving. Create monuments strategically. Survive the chaos. Get rid of your shady overlord.

short_description: Lead a small group of Earthlings who think they're serving God, but you're actually helping a crashed alien who just pretends to be an artist. Juggle frantic orders, gather precious resources, and survive chaos triggered by your anxious, incompetent overlord.

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-9600/AMD Ryzen 5 2600X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX970/AMD Radeon R9 390
